ValidationRule.description: All agreements related to the master agreements L198, L710, 1263 and L1263 must have an Age Asset
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( MasterConvention__r.Name = 'L198', MasterConvention__r.Name = 'L710', MasterConvention__r.Name = '1263', MasterConvention__r.Name = 'L1263' ), ISBLANK(TEXT(AssetAge__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This sub-distributor agreement must have an age asset indication.
